source_files: Assembly101 coarse_labels (public Google Drive annotation folder): assembly_<same recording ids>.txt
note: Each example is one assembly recording's complete mistake-detection CSV (coarse attach/detach steps labelled correct / mistake / correction with a free-text remark; lanes 'step', 'mistake', 'correction') together with its complete coarse-action label file (lane 'action'). Both files count frames at 30 fps; the timeline divides by 30. No clip: the videos on Hugging Face sit behind an access gate our token is not on, and we did not accept the gate for the user.
